svg.text: cpu.vhd — top level: core, boot ROM, RAM, MMIO address decoder
Instructions come from the boot ROM or the RAM (picked by PC); loads read RAM, ROM or a peripheral (picked by address).
interselmux: PC in ROM → 00, PC ≥ 0x8000_0000 → 01, else 1x → 0
Address decode is combinational; RAM writes on the clock edge.
